summary: Both subject and prompt held at their dispatched digests, both read-only, and the turn-1 subject is still frozen at 080a3c20… so the lineage is intact. The claimed repair is real and exact: line 3 now reads 'DRAFT — under review', which is verbatim what turn-1 C2-D051-053-SF1 asked for. A full diff against the turn-1 draft shows only two changes — that line, and three added lines recording turn-1 outcomes — so every substantive finding from turn 1 carries on byte-identical text, and I re-confirmed the load-bearing ones anyway: all five D-002 rides still disclosed and partitioned, all three entries still severable with one-row subjects, seven-row exclusions and distinct overturn codes, and the no-disposition / no-SATISFIED / condition-5 clauses each present three times.
